method.google: Three distinct PageSpeed Insights API runs per URL and device. Use the per-page median. API audit values and test settings are included below.
method.debugbear: One run per URL and device from US East. Five completed pairs per device.
method.pingdom: One run per URL from San Francisco.
method.gtmetrix: One run per URL from Seattle, unthrottled. Four completed pairs.

notes: Hosted lab tests of the deployed sites. Integrations differed between hosts; cache state was not controlled.
Each chart uses only completed pairs for its service. Scores are not pooled between services.
Averages give each page equal weight. Google averages use the per-page three-run medians.
The Google API does not return a shareable PageSpeed report URL. Its links point to our saved display of the returned data.
